title: Bill of Rights, Amendment VII: jury trial in common-law suits above twenty dollars
summary: The National Archives transcription of Amendment VII, ratified 15 December 1791, is the text this card reports.
body: The National Archives transcription of the Bill of Rights gives Amendment VII, ratified on 15 December 1791. The following is a close rendering in modern spelling, not a character-for-character copy of the enrolled capitalisation: In suits at common law, where the value in controversy shall exceed twenty dollars, the right of trial by jury shall be preserved, and no fact tried by a jury shall be otherwise re-examined in any court of the United States than according to the rules of the common law. The Archives page keeps the capitalisation of the enrolled resolution. This card reports the operative rule. It does not collect later cases that have read the sentence.

sources.title: The Bill of Rights: A Transcription
sources.author: U.S. National Archives
sources.note: Transcription opened 2026-11-18. The card quotes the transcript. It does not add a later political reading unless a second opened page says it.

said_by: United States Congress and the ratifying states
